title: Four Pillars of Destiny
fortune.great.message: Today all things flow smoothly — act on what you desire.
fortune.good.message: Good energy surrounds you today — move forward with confidence.
fortune.neutral.message: A calm day ahead — maintain your inner peace.
fortune.minor.message: Small challenges may arise — proceed with care.
fortune.poor.message: Energy is blocked today — postpone important matters and rest.
dayMasterType.gap.name: Gap-mok (甲木)
dayMasterType.eul.name: Eul-mok (乙木)
dayMasterType.byeong.name: Byeong-hwa (丙火)
dayMasterType.jeong.name: Jeong-hwa (丁火)
dayMasterType.mu.name: Mu-to (戊土)
dayMasterType.gi.name: Gi-to (己土)
dayMasterType.gyeong.name: Gyeong-geum (庚金)
dayMasterType.sin.name: Sin-geum (辛金)
dayMasterType.im.name: Im-su (壬水)
dayMasterType.gye.name: Gye-su (癸水)
dayMasterOmen.gap.0: The energy of Gap-mok dwells within you — like bamboo reaching for the sky, you grow ever upward.
dayMasterOmen.gap.1: With the spirit of a great tree, you embrace the world — you shall walk the path of righteousness.
dayMasterOmen.gap.2: Like a spring sprout, your energy rises — new beginnings bring good fortune.
dayMasterOmen.eul.0: The gentle energy of Eul-mok embraces you — though the wind sways you, you shall not break.
dayMasterOmen.eul.1: Like a vine climbing over walls, your flexibility brings benefit in all things.
dayMasterOmen.eul.2: Like a flower spreading fragrance, your charm draws people near.
dayMasterOmen.byeong.0: The light of Byeong-hwa dwells within you — like the sun, you illuminate the world.
dayMasterOmen.byeong.1: Blazing passion is yours — you shall achieve all you desire.
dayMasterOmen.byeong.2: Bright energy dispels darkness — no obstacle shall block your path.
dayMasterOmen.jeong.0: The warmth of Jeong-hwa is yours — like a candle, you light up those around you.
dayMasterOmen.jeong.1: Your gentle glow melts hearts — connections shall never cease.
dayMasterOmen.jeong.2: With a delicate eye, you see the world — you perceive what others miss.
dayMasterOmen.mu.0: The steadfastness of Mu-to is yours — like a great mountain, you are a pillar of strength.
dayMasterOmen.mu.1: Your unwavering earthen energy stabilizes all around you — trust shall be yours.
dayMasterOmen.mu.2: With a vast embrace, you nurture all things — people gather by your side.
dayMasterOmen.gi.0: The energy of Gi-to flows through you — like a fertile garden, you nurture all that grows.
dayMasterOmen.gi.1: Like soft earth cradling seeds, your acceptance warms all who approach.
dayMasterOmen.gi.2: Holding the center in perfect balance — the path of harmony opens before you.
dayMasterOmen.gyeong.0: The strength of Gyeong-geum is yours — like a boulder, you stand unshaken.
dayMasterOmen.gyeong.1: Sharp as a blade, your decisiveness cuts through hesitation — forge ahead without pause.
dayMasterOmen.gyeong.2: A principled heart opens the way — you walk the righteous path.
dayMasterOmen.sin.0: The brilliance of Sin-geum is yours — like a jewel, your worth shall be revealed.
dayMasterOmen.sin.1: With artisan's hands, you refine the world — the pinnacle of mastery awaits.
dayMasterOmen.sin.2: Sharp insight pierces to the truth — you shall not be deceived.
dayMasterOmen.im.0: The depth of Im-su is yours — like a great river, you encompass the world.
dayMasterOmen.im.1: Like flowing water, nothing obstructs you — all things shall proceed smoothly.
dayMasterOmen.im.2: With a wise mind you survey the world — you shall never lose your way.
dayMasterOmen.gye.0: The cleverness of Gye-su is yours — like raindrops, you find your way by seeping through.
dayMasterOmen.gye.1: Like drops of water wearing through stone, persistence shall fulfill your purpose.
dayMasterOmen.gye.2: Adapting fluidly to change — you shine in any circumstance.
elementOmen.wood.strong: Wood energy is abundant — growth and progress overflow. Auspicious for new beginnings, but beware of excess.
elementOmen.wood.weak: Wood energy is lacking — cultivate patience and growth. Like a seed awaiting spring, bide your time.
elementOmen.wood.balanced: Wood energy is in harmony — you shall grow naturally.
elementOmen.fire.strong: Fire energy is abundant — passion and brightness overflow. Illuminate the world, but guard against burnout.
elementOmen.fire.weak: Fire energy is lacking — kindle the flame within. Even a small candle lights the darkness.
elementOmen.fire.balanced: Fire energy is in harmony — warmth shall abound.
elementOmen.earth.strong: Earth energy is abundant — trust and stability overflow. Hold your center, but beware of stubbornness.
elementOmen.earth.weak: Earth energy is lacking — seek firm ground. Finding stability brings peace of mind.
elementOmen.earth.balanced: Earth energy is in harmony — your center stands firm.
elementOmen.metal.strong: Metal energy is abundant — decisiveness and drive overflow. Sharpen your edge, but avoid causing harm.
elementOmen.metal.weak: Metal energy is lacking — steel your resolve. Through refinement, brilliance shall emerge.
elementOmen.metal.balanced: Metal energy is in harmony — clear and bright decisions shall be yours.
elementOmen.water.strong: Water energy is abundant — wisdom and insight overflow. Think deeply, but don't lose the current.
elementOmen.water.weak: Water energy is lacking — fill the well of wisdom. Through learning, light shall appear.
elementOmen.water.balanced: Water energy is in harmony — like clear water, you reflect all things.
elementBalanced: The five elements are evenly distributed — a balanced destiny. You shall live a harmonious life.
elementTemplate: {{strongest}} energy is strong and {{weakest}} energy is weak.
zodiacOmen.rat: With the clever energy of Ja-si, you seize opportunities — great things arise from small beginnings.
zodiacOmen.ox: With the steadfast energy of Chuk-si, you press forward — efforts shall bear fruit.
zodiacOmen.tiger: With the courageous energy of In-si, you command the world — advance without fear.
zodiacOmen.rabbit: With the gentle energy of Myo-si, you draw people near — the path of harmony opens.
zodiacOmen.dragon: With the mystical energy of Jin-si, you soar through the skies — unfold your grand vision.
zodiacOmen.snake: With the wise energy of Sa-si, you think deeply — you penetrate to the truth.
zodiacOmen.horse: With the spirited energy of O-si, you gallop forward — nothing shall obstruct you.
zodiacOmen.sheep: With the gentle energy of Mi-si, you create harmony — peace shall dwell with you.
zodiacOmen.monkey: With the witty energy of Sin-si, you overcome crisis — difficulties become opportunities.
zodiacOmen.rooster: With the diligent energy of Yu-si, you observe precisely — no mistakes shall be made.
zodiacOmen.dog: With the loyal energy of Sul-si, you keep faith — trust shall be yours.
zodiacOmen.pig: With the blessed energy of Hae-si, you enjoy abundance — leisure graces all your affairs.
